title: Social Post: Ghost Drone Video Goes Viral

fields.imageBrief: drone hovering above a wooden lodge patio, sunlight glinting off its body, meadow behind, no visible operator
fields.caption: UAS-11 just flew over the lodge, dropped a fake drone, and vanished. Is this a hack? #BirchHollowIncident #GhostDrone #UAS11

comments.text: This isn’t a test. The GCS just showed a second device ID. We’re not on the flight line.
I saw it hover for 10 seconds. No one on the patio. Then it zipped west. Was that a drone or a glitch?

instructorNote: This inject escalates social pressure. The PIO must log and forward it per C2; do not let the team draft a public response.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance at an open grass flight test field: a multirotor drone on a landing pad, a crew in high-visibility vests at a folding table, orange cones, a windsock, clear sky. Phone snapshot taken from behind a wooden patio railing at midday. A small, dark drone hovers 15 feet above a weathered wooden deck, sunlight glinting off its matte black body. The meadow behind is golden and slightly wind-blown, with distant trees. No person is visible on the patio. The drone's rotors are silent, and its undercarriage is empty. The sky is clear, and the lens shows a slight motion blur on the edges. The background is softly out of focus, with a faint shadow of a person's hand visible near the bottom edge of the frame, not touching the device. The image is slightly tilted, as if captured in haste. logos, or brand identifiers are visible on the drone or surrounding surfaces.
